topic: How to turn your teen's screen time into skill-building time
caption:
Your teen is already spending 7+ hours a day on a screen. What if 30 minutes of that built a real skill and earned real money? Pick one thing they're already good at, video editing, design, tutoring, and help them offer it to one person this week. Give them a head start at hustleup.us

copy.headline: Turn Scroll Time Into Skill Time This Week
copy.body: Pick one skill your teen already enjoys, like video editing or gaming, and challenge them to offer it as a service to one neighbor or family friend this week.
